source.title: [Bounty #743] Validate /api/reviews payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

POST /api/reviews forwards req.body directly to createReview without schema validation. Any JSON object is accepted, including invalid rating ranges (e.g. negative numbers or numbers > 5), missing targetId, missing reviewerId, empty or excessively long comments, and prototype pollution fields. The in-memory review store then persists malformed reviews, degrading data integrity and breaking client consumers.

## Requested fix

Add a strict Zod schema for review creation and validate the request in reviewController before persistence. Accept only valid rating integers between 1 and 5, require valid reviewerId and targetId strings, sanitize and bound optional comment text (1 to 2000 chars), and reject malformed payloads with a 400 Bad Request error. Add focused route/service tests for valid payload, out-of-range rating, missing required fields, and unknown property rejection.

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty. I will submit a PR that references this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700
